tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: Purpose: List modules, descriptions, and operation counts. Use when: Starting catalog discovery. Next: Call list_operations with a module name.

tools.name: list_operations
tools.description: Purpose: List a module's operations, optionally filtered by read or write kind. Use when: Choosing an operation in a known module. Next: Call describe_operation with an operation name.

tools.name: describe_operation
tools.description: Purpose: Show payload schema, optional example, envelope arguments, lint findings, and availability. Use when: Preparing a selected operation. Next: If submittable, call run_query for a read or send_command for a write.

tools.name: send_command
tools.description: Purpose: Submit a write through EventStore. Use when: describe_operation shows a submittable write and the payload and envelope are ready. Next: Inspect the accepted result or error before any further action; a gateway-timeout or gateway-unreachable error does not prove rejection, so do not resubmit automatically.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Purpose: Read through EventStore and return a document with optional paging. Use when: describe_operation shows a submittable read and the payload and envelope are ready. Next: Inspect the document and use the returned cursor for another page when present.
